description: Source code implementing DRM screen capture functionality, including initialization, screen info retrieval, frame capture, and cleanup, using Linux DRM and ioctl calls.

classes.name: DRMScreenCapture
classes.description: Class representing DRM-based screen capture handle with methods for initialization, info retrieval, frame capture, and cleanup.

classes.name: DRMContext
classes.description: Structure holding DRM file descriptor, kms context, and offset for screen capture operations.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Init
methods.description: Initializes and allocates resources for DRM screen capture, returning a handle.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_GetScreenInfo
methods.description: Retrieves screen information and primary buffer details for the DRM device.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_ScreenCapture
methods.description: Captures a screenshot frame into the provided output buffer.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the DRM screen capture handle.
